title: Public key trust stores need deployment governance evidence
remediation: The deployment sponsor determines where public key infrastructure is used for authentication. The deployment public key infrastructure owner approves a common method to provision, update and remove trust anchors across in-scope network, operating system, browser and application platforms. Collect the redacted trust-store inventory and sampled configuration and change records. Verify that an authorized trust anchor works and that an unapproved or removed anchor is refused. Record gaps and sponsor-approved applicability decisions per platform.

milestones.title: Confirm public key authentication scope and collect approved trust-store procedures, sampled platforms and trust-anchor acceptance and refusal receipts
